extracted.name: Alaskan Cod and Shrimp with Fresh Tomato
extracted.description: This meal is very yummy, juicy, easy to cook, and convenient. It's ready in half an hour!
ingredient_lines: 0.5 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 tablespoon dried oregano, or to taste
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic; cook and stir until golden brown, taking care not to burn garlic. Add tomatoes; cook and stir until juices released. Stir in 1 teaspoon oregano.

Place cod and shrimp on tomato mixture; season with salt. Cover skillet; simmer 3 minutes. Flip cod; season with salt and 1 tablespoon oregano; cover and cook 3 minutes more. Remove cover; cook until juices evaporate slightly, 2 to 3 minutes.
